Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Helios is renewing the dedicated capacity pool and adding the +2x capacity burst for Q3. To get procurement unstuck on our side please can you:

Appreciate a quick reply — aim to get this into your procurement queue today so we can hit the July 1 start date.

Best,
